This yields an exact two-period flag formula and proves T_N^4=id, T_N^2=id for odd N. Necessary and sufficient fixed-point conditions and free independent site cosets give F1 and F2; Burnside/Möbius identities give exact C1/C2/C4. Bijection and unique c,d for nonzero masks justify distinct-map counts. The actual supplied checker proves 1,760,824 finite exact assertions including independent quantum YBE, complete small-space enumeration, and affine-classification checks; finite checks are not substituted for infinite proof. The distinction between nonbraided YBE and the braid equation is explicit.
